comment: Disorganized and usually 15 minutes late getting class started. We had of three assignments graded by the last week of classes. Puzzled why this class is a prerequisite for Biology200 because I really did not learn anything. Lectures were read off of slides that would not have required my being there to understand. Frusterating but thankfully easy.

The worst professor I have ever had. He was months behind on grading, offered no preparation materials for exams, never posted a schedule for the year, would give us quizzes and exams with little to no notice, and canceled class frequently. The class was boring and unfocused. He put more emphasis on memorizing bird songs than learning biology.
